# tl-8mb: release.py: queue and rebase under its own lock instead of refusing non-fast-forward
chore · P2 · auto

## Description
2026-10-24: with 4 sessions releasing, the gallery release restarted twice (main moved while it waited, refused as non-ff), and each restart costs a 20-25 min suite. release.py should take a release lock, fetch+rebase the branch inside it, then run the suite, so whoever holds the lock always tests what it pushes.

## Acceptance criteria
Done when: dev/release.py takes a release lock, then fetches and rebases --from-branch onto origin/main inside it before running the suite, so a release never fails as non-fast-forward because another release landed while it waited; a second release.py started meanwhile waits and prints the holder; a test covers two releases in sequence.
